The main takeaway from our work is that
the capacity of a reversible watermarking scheme can be improved significantly if the embedding is performed on the histogram of the difference image.
the capacity of the Coltuc approach is not only limited to the capacity of the lossless compression of the image but also to the capacity of a second lossless compression of a histogram of the image.
a reversible watermarking solution can be designed by considering the histogram of the difference image.
